scope: Online rolling 2D plan preview using Point-LIO; not saved-map localization or autonomous navigation
limitations: Controller not launched or tested; no FollowPath, NavigateToPose, sport bridge or command transport.
Height band 0.15..1.6 m in initial map frame: level-floor preview, no slope/stair/cliff traversability evaluation.
Robot radius 0.22 m inherited from 2D configuration, not a validated walking envelope.
Point-LIO twist not validated for controller input; body velocity conversion required before motion.
Observed zero cmd_vel is a bounded observation, not proof of navigation safety.
